subject: Brightline - new parent company remittance (wire)
text:
Dear Accounts Payable,

Brightline Office Supply Inc has been reorganised under Brightline Holdings Ltd. From 1 December, please settle all Brightline Office Supply invoices by international wire to our group treasury account rather than by domestic ACH:

Beneficiary: Brightline Holdings Ltd
Bank: Barclays Bank UK PLC, London
IBAN: GB29 BARC 2000 0055 7799 02
SWIFT/BIC: BARCGB22
Intermediary (USD): Citibank N.A. New York, ABA 021000089

Kindly acknowledge receipt.

Kind regards,
Group Finance
Brightline Holdings Ltd
label: change_request
note: Switch from domestic ACH to an international wire for a newly named parent entity; money lands in a different account.
